title: The Living Constellation — Interactive Forest Skill Tree
notes: New full-screen interactive circular Moonwood Skill Tree inspired by the approved gothic-purple reference artwork. Dedicated Skill Tree page with Seraphine portrait, eight selectable nodes and an updating skill-details panel. Forest Mastery upgrades and optional confirmed point refunds work with your existing save. The Home and Characters skill buttons open the full tree directly without flashing. Other talents are clearly marked as planned; auto-update checks remain every 5 seconds.
